$comment: 听力训练营 L13（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，主旨直白）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段独白 5 空，本课只填数字和时间，含一个价格数字）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: The Big Sale
intro: 商店里的五段短话：促销、买礼物、营业时间、丢东西、找玩具；再听一段商店促销广播，记下时间、天数、价格和人数。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Good afternoon, everyone. This week all sports clothes are half price, so a T-shirt is only five pounds.
You can find them on the second floor, next to the shoes. The sale ends on Sunday.

questions.q: What is the woman talking about?
questions.explain: half price / only five pounds / the sale ends on Sunday——在说打折。不是新店，也没讲几点开门。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Sam, it's Mum's birthday on Saturday. What can we get her?
She likes reading. What about a book, or a nice bag?
A bag is too expensive. Let's get a book and some chocolate.
Good idea. The bookshop is on the first floor.

questions.q: What are Emma and Sam talking about?
questions.explain: What can we get her / a book, or a bag / let's get a book and some chocolate——在商量买什么礼物。没有说派对，书店只是去买书的地方。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Hello, this is Dan from Dan's Sports Shop. From next Monday we are open from eight in the morning until eight at night.
On Sundays we open at ten and close at four. So now you can shop before school or after work.

questions.q: What is the man talking about?
options: a new shop in the town
questions.explain: open from eight until eight / on Sundays we open at ten and close at four——全是营业时间。不是新店，也没有说打折。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Excuse me, I think I left my purse in your shop. It's small and red.
Let me look. Was it near the shoes?
Yes, I was looking at some trainers there about ten minutes ago.
Here it is! Someone found it on the chair.

questions.q: Why is the girl talking to the man?
options: She lost something in the shop.
She wants to buy some trainers.
She wants to change her shoes.
questions.explain: I think I left my purse in your shop——她来找丢的钱包。试鞋只是刚才做过的事，不是现在的目的。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Are you looking for toys? They are not on the ground floor any more.
Take the lift to the third floor. Games and books are there too, on your left when you come out of the lift.

questions.q: What is the man telling the customers?
questions.explain: not on the ground floor / take the lift to the third floor / on your left——在说玩具在哪儿。价格和新品一个字没提。

sections.intro: 听一段商店促销广播，把笔记补全。每个空填一个数字或一个时间。

script.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to our big summer sale.
The sale starts tomorrow, and the doors open at half past eight, one hour earlier than on other days, so come early.
The sale is on for three days, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. On Sunday we close at six, not four.
The best thing in the sale is the trainers. They were thirty pounds, and now they are only twenty pounds.
And the first fifty customers on Friday morning get a free bag. Last year it was the first twenty, so this year more people will get one.
Thank you for shopping with us, and see you tomorrow!

questions.explain: the doors open at half past eight = 8:30。one hour earlier 说的是比平时早一小时，不是时间本身。

questions.q: The sale is on for: ______ days
questions.explain: on for three days = 3，后面还数了 Friday, Saturday and Sunday。
on Sunday we close at six, not four。four 被 not 否定。
now they are only twenty pounds = 20。thirty 是原价。

questions.q: Free bag for the first ______ customers
questions.explain: the first fifty customers = 50。twenty 是去年的人数。
